prompt_exact.distance.r1:
Create original ChirpNeighbors San Diego coastal urban GARDEN pixel art, ONE requested production layer. Landscape1536x1024 canvas, same origin and gentle elevated side-view perspective across layers. Rich naturalistic connected PIXEL CLUSTERS, clear square stepped silhouettes, coherent value bands and restrained selective highlights. Finely detailed near materials but broad calm grouping: no uniform noise/stipple, no smooth vector shapes, no over-sharpened photorealism, no bloom. Palette: pale cool blue-gray distance; muted mustard/ochre/olive plants; sparse near dark olive/brown framing. Soft upper-left diffuse daylight with consistent attached lower-right shadows. The central/lower-middle turf MUST be lighter/calmer than an ordinary textured grass background so small dark birds/contact points remain legible later. Preserve an open stage x=340..1240,y=650..980; dense/dark vegetation only at sparse edges. Actual project bird/prop candidates were inspected for text-only visual coherence; no image references supplied in these first calls. No birds, animals, people, functional feeder/bath/fountain, UI, labels, lettering, boats, lake, alpine scenery, decorative frame or copied composition. Not a flattened finished scene: produce only the requested layer.

OPAQUE SKY/DISTANCE ONLY. Calm marine-influenced coastal urban garden atmosphere: a broad luminous pale blue-gray sky opening, soft low-contrast cloud value bands with minimal cloud detail. Near y=470..540 a few distant muted low roofs and irregular tree canopy masses with varied heights and clear gaps, no striking skyline. Distant shapes are simpler, lighter and cooler than foreground. The entire bottom half is quiet broad pale gray-green underpaint to be covered by a ground plate. No lawn, near planting, close wall, pots, near trunks or branches. No bright giant cloud focal point; birds will be the focus later. Entire canvas opaque.

prompt_exact.flexible_foliage.r1:
Generate ONE new independent FLEXIBLE FOLIAGE transparent-alpha layer for this original ChirpNeighbors coastal garden. Use the supplied image ONLY as this project's own placement/style guide. It is an assembly of three newly generated project layers, not an external reference screenshot. Do NOT reproduce the assembled scene. Output exactly full landscape1536x1024 transparent PNG canvas containing only flexible vegetation in the listed peripheral groups, registered to the exact same positions. Naturalistic connected square pixel clusters, clearly stepped silhouettes, restrained selective warm highlights, muted olive/sage/ochre palette, soft upper-left light. Near edges may be dark olive/brown but never a thick border. No uniformly noisy stipple, no smooth vector foliage, no broad glow/halo, no matte, no fake checkerboard. The broad lighter muted-green central/lower-middle bird/contact stage is reserved and must stay completely transparent in this overlay: x=300..1300,y=570..1024.

1. LEFT POT FOLIAGE: one modest compact airy sage/olive small-leaf plant above the left pot. Root stems meet the existing pot soil at [135,775]. Foliage occupies roughly x=25..245,y=585..780; natural gaps, varied small branches, no giant flower, no plant height beyond y=560. Draw plant leaves and fine flexible stems only. Do NOT draw pot, soil, floor or pot shadow.
2. RIGHT BRANCH FOLIAGE: sparse broken leaf clusters only around the two existing tree branch tips at approximately [1220,125] and [1300,355], plus extreme top-right fringe. Keep main right trunk and large branch silhouettes EMPTY/transparent so the unchanged rigid wood layer below remains visible. The upper group is mainly x=1120..1480,y=25..220; the lower group mainly x=1220..1510,y=255..460. Irregular varied heights, branching gaps and light passing through. Fine flexible twiglets may connect leaf clusters, but DO NOT redraw any major wood/trunk or create a broad canopy arch. Center sky x=300..1100 must remain clear.
3. SHALLOW BACK-BORDER FOLIAGE: only two or three LOW uneven muted sage/olive plant islands attached to the bare bed rootline near y=535, at x=300..510 and x=910..1160 and optionally far-right x=1450..1536. Maximum height about55px above bed, no dense continuous hedge. Leave long quiet gaps; no high-contrast flowers. Draw foliage/fine flexible stems only; no wall, planting soil, stones or ground.

Everything else is REAL transparent alpha. No birds, animals, people, feeders, baths, fountains, architecture, sky, clouds, distant landscape, turf, rigid pot/trunk/major branches, text or UI. This is actual separate vegetation art, not animation or physics. The project reference image has no source screenshot and no canonical bird pixels; no birds should be drawn or baked in.
